text:
Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Medium Fan-Embossed Planter, 6"H, Blue
Colors: Blue
Materials: Ceramic
This eye-catching planter is the perfect vessel for a plant, flower, or other greenery of your choice, or you can choose to keep it empty or use it to display other items in your home. The blue color will look great in any room or outdoor space. 6.7" diameter x 6"H; 6" interior diameter 100% ceramic stoneware This natural stoneware pot is perfect for showing off your favorite flower or plant and includes a drainage hole. With an embossed fan pattern in blue glaze, there's no wrong way to display this classic pot. Fill it with your favorite plant or keep it empty. No assembly required Hand wash with a wet cloth.
